sections.text_helper: Section 70.4.9 "MDIOS output data register x (MDIOS_DOUTRx)" in chapter 70 (Management data input/output (MDIOS)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3614.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x180 + 0x4 * x, (x = 0 to 31)
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:16 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 15:0 DOUT[15:0]: output data sent to MDIO master during read frames
This field is written by software. These 16 bits are serially output on the MDIO bus during
read frames, which address the MDIOS register x.
